Anatomy Decision Checklist

Learning outcome: Apply the anatomy checklist before deciding that a dense structure is suspicious.

Use this checklist before deciding that a dense structure is suspicious. Select each coloured segment to check the route, movement, normal structures, pattern, position and texture, then resolve anything that remains unexplained. Use several clues together.
